_about: MPC-9884: hosts that appear in code but are never contacted by a visitor's browser or by our servers. Kept SMALL on purpose: XML/JSON-LD namespaces and reserved example names. A host that is actually fetched belongs in recipients.json, not here. Every line needs a reason. link_properties are object keys whose URL value is a citation or a navigation link shown to a person (a documentation source, an href), not a request; an <a href> in JSX is exempt for the same reason.

_about_link_hosts: MPC-9886: hosts that appear in the site's code ONLY as the destination of a link the visitor chooses to open (a share button, a social profile, 'learn more', a window.open on a click) or as text we show for the visitor to type into their own settings. Our code never fetches them and the page does not load them; the browser navigates only when the visitor clicks. The static scan accepts them; the built-site CRAWL does not (a REQUEST to one of these hosts is still a finding), so a link host that becomes a real call is caught. A host we actually contact belongs in recipients.json.
